notes.title: Update! New Random Skirmish map sizes and options!
notes.content:
Listening to player feedback we've added new skirmish mode map sizes.  We think these new maps are just the right size. Big enough to allow enough strategy and tactics but still make for relatively short, exciting play sessions!

There are now options for small, medium, and large, randomly generated skirmish maps!

Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Pirates! Showdown: Enhanced Edition - Skirmish Overhaul Update
notes.content:
Ahoy, captains! Just in time for the Steam Summer Sale, we've got a treasure trove of skirmish mode improvements, including smaller quick encounter skirmish map, in our latest update to Pirates! Showdown: Enhanced Edition. This patch focuses on enhancing your skirmish mode experience, with new options to keep your battles fresh and exciting.

Key Features:
1. New Skirmish Map Sizes: Set sail on compact battlegrounds with our newly added smaller skirmish maps. Perfect for quick, intense encounters!

2. Improved Map Balance: We've fine-tuned existing maps to ensure fair and strategic gameplay for all players. Expect more balanced resource distribution and strategic points.

3. Miscellaneous Tweaks and Fixes: We've also addressed various minor issues and made small improvements throughout the game to enhance overall stability and performance.

Note: This update coincides with the Steam Summer Sale - a perfect time for new pirates to join the crew or for veterans to gift the game to their mates!

Weigh anchor and dive into these exciting new changes! We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work to make Pirates! Showdown: Enhanced Edition the ultimate pirate strategy experience.

Fair winds and following seas, mateys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832416/7567a5216c72a603cb85d352a47f0741172ef708.png[/img]

notes.title: April 5th Update!
notes.content:
Hello!

We tried to take some of the top suggestions from the community and improve some gameplay aspects!

-Obelisks are different colors and clearly look different from each other now
-Significantly increased number of allowed ships so it shouldn't be often that you hit the "max ships" limit
-When you hover over a building/structure you own, it displays an indicator so you know that you are over that structure if you want to upgrade it
-Tweaked the mouse input to hopefully fix issues some users have seen with not always launching a ship when expected (it seemed to only happen with a small number of certain mice)
-Updated some of the small island models to look better
-Other misc. tweaks


Bug fixes
-Fix occasional missing text on pause menu
-Other misc. small bug fixes.


Happy Pillaging!

notes.title: Early Access release
notes.content:
[h1]Ahoy, fellow buccaneers and sea-lovers![/h1]

We're thrilled to announce that "Pirates! Showdown: Enhanced Edition" our eagerly-awaited PC remastered and enhanced version of our classic real-time strategy game, is now available in Early Access on Steam! Set sail on a thrilling adventure across the high seas, where strategy and quick thinking are your best allies in ship-to-ship battles.

In Pirates! Showdown, you'll take on the role of a fearless pirate captain, building and commanding your fleet to conquer the waves. Our game offers a unique, simplified RTS/defense experience, focusing on fun and engaging gameplay that's easy to pick up but offers deep strategic possibilities.

Join our community here on Steam, share your experiences, suggest improvements, or just chat with fellow pirate enthusiasts. Your input will help shape the future of the game.

Set sail with us on this exciting adventure. Your pirate fleet awaits!

Fair winds and following seas,
The Pirates! Showdown: Enhanced Edition Commander Team 🏴‍☠️⚓


[h3]Main features:[/h3]
[b]Streamlined RTS[/b] without heavy resource management or the need to micromanage units
[b]Command Your Fleet[/b] and capture towns, forts, enemy bases and more
[b]Use a variety of strategies[/b], Rush the enemy or hold back and build up your resources and fleet
[b]75 Unique stages in 4 worlds[/b], Combat the enemy in the tropical Caribbean then follow them into Hades on the River Styx, and more!  All with adjustable difficulty
[b]Randomly Generated skirmish maps[/b] for infinite variety
[b]Remastered and enhanced for PC[/b]
[b]Multiplayer mode coming soon[/b]



[h3]Early Access state:[/h3]
-The single player campaign is fully playable with over 75 maps plus randomly generated skirmish maps
-Graphics are still in the process of being remastered so look for some areas to improve
-Multiplayer mode coming soon
-Additional enhancements for PC
